role_assignments_dates_order.name: role_assignments_dates_order
role_assignments_dates_order.value: "crucible"."role_assignments"."to_on" is null or "crucible"."role_assignments"."from_on" is null or "crucible"."role_assignments"."to_on" >= "crucible"."role_assignments"."from_on"

bookings_actual_order.name: bookings_actual_order
bookings_actual_order.value: "crucible"."bookings"."actual_end_at" is null or "crucible"."bookings"."actual_start_at" is null or "crucible"."bookings"."actual_end_at" >= "crucible"."bookings"."actual_start_at"

scenarios_decided_dated.name: scenarios_decided_dated
scenarios_decided_dated.value: "crucible"."scenarios"."status" not in ('accepted', 'rejected') or "crucible"."scenarios"."decided_at" is not null

api_clients_webhook_secret.name: api_clients_webhook_secret
api_clients_webhook_secret.value: "crucible"."api_clients"."webhook_url" is null or "crucible"."api_clients"."webhook_secret" is not null

api_events_subject.name: api_events_subject
api_events_subject.value: ("crucible"."api_events"."kind" like 'booking.%' and "crucible"."api_events"."booking_id" is not null) or ("crucible"."api_events"."kind" like 'incident.%' and "crucible"."api_events"."incident_id" is not null)

consumable_moves_quantity_sign.name: consumable_moves_quantity_sign
consumable_moves_quantity_sign.value: ("crucible"."consumable_moves"."kind" = 'receipt' and "crucible"."consumable_moves"."quantity" > 0) or ("crucible"."consumable_moves"."kind" in ('use', 'discard') and "crucible"."consumable_moves"."quantity" < 0) or ("crucible"."consumable_moves"."kind" = 'adjust' and "crucible"."consumable_moves"."quantity" <> 0)
